name: replicated_warm_budget_regime_map
description: 90 cells total in 15 fixed (n,seed) shards. Each method gets twelve candidates and four synchronized seconds per candidate including fresh construction, transfer, preconditioner, updates, validation and snapshots. Symmetric discarded compile warmup is separately recorded. All methods use the same training/validation/test streams. Selection and weight hash are saved before test creation. This measures warmed implementation performance; no cold end-to-end timing or theorem-certified projection parameter claim.
